svg.text: Layered web system: Next.js client · Express REST API · domain services · MongoDB · open-data APIs
REST / JSON over HTTPS · Bearer JWT
Seeded from a committed open-data snapshot (OSM parks, GBIF records).
Abundance is derived from observations on read — never stored as a count.
* optional AI vision (Gemini free tier, Groq, Ollama or Claude) for wildlife species identification · dashed border = optional
